## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm lint`
- [ ] `pnpm format:check`
- [ ] `pnpm check`
- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] `pnpm build`
- [ ] `npm pack --dry-run --ignore-scripts`

## Safety

- [ ] No unrelated files changed.
- [ ] No secrets, private logs, generated reports, or `.env` files included.
- [ ] Agent behavior, scoring, or security changes include regression tests.
- [ ] Public docs were updated when behavior changed.
